measurement_note: Size is n, the number of regular workers; each tier has n distinct exact-match tasks plus one high-profit unmatched task for the extra worker. Tiers 32, 128, and 512 span 16x. Reversed task order prevents a repeated linear search from finding matches early, while the accepted skill-group heap solution remains near-linear on these singleton groups. A correct baseline that scans all remaining tasks for every worker must return every expected profit and fail only scaling.
